scope.summary: Implement orifice penetration correctives (spec 13.21; PREQ-019): stretch/conform morphs on the vaginal, anal, and oral orifices driven by penetrator proximity and depth via the MT-534 ProximityDriver - the orifice opening conforms to penetrator girth and the canal walls conform along insertion depth, automatically, with no per-frame keyframing.
acceptance_criteria: Orifice receivers registered: vaginal canal (MT-549 axis), anal canal (MT-553 axis), and an oral cavity axis; each exposes normalized depth plus girth-fit parameters from the ProximityDriver.

Stretch/conform correctives: the orifice opening stretches with penetrator girth as proximity ramps to depth, and interior canal walls conform along the insertion path; no visible interpenetration at documented penetrator sizes including MT-551 oversized extremes.
Activation is purely driver-driven: posing a penetrator through the orifice animates the correctives automatically and deterministically (MT-534 envelope).
Composition with gape dials: manual gape plus penetration stretch combine under a documented max-blend policy without double-stretch artifacts.
scope.risk_if_missed: Penetration is the defining adult interaction (PREQ-019); without driver-driven orifice stretch, every insertion shot either interpenetrates or needs per-frame hand animation - the modding-world hack (VaM/Skyrim bone-constraint tricks) BodyKit promised to make first-class.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
